title: 1816 Prairie's balcony over the porch, with a door onto it
items: The iron balcony on top of the Henderson house's porch at 1816 Prairie now stands about a metre high, as the old photograph shows it, where it used to be a low rail.
The tall window above the front door now opens onto that balcony as a pair of glass doors, its carved hood and crest kept over it.
